_overrides_note: Adding an entry here does not apply it. Overrides take effect during dependency resolution, and npm skips resolution when node_modules already exists — it reports 'up to date' and rebuilds the lockfile from the tree. brace-expansion and js-yaml sat unpatched that way while this block looked like it was protecting them. To add or change an entry: remove node_modules, delete package-lock.json, run `npm install --package-lock-only`, then verify with `npm ls <pkg>` — never by reading this file.
